newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal completes $515 mln Owen merger.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal completes $515 mln Owen merger.

text.p: Cardinal Health Inc said on Wednesday it completed its acquisition of Owen Healthcare Inc for stock, and will issue 8.39 million shares in a deal valued at $515 million.
Owen shareholders will receive 0.45 of a Cardinal share for each Owen share they hold.

When the deal originally was announced in November 1996, Owen shareholders were to receive 0.3150 of a Cardinal share, and Cardinal planned to issue between 5.49 million and 6.07 million shares. But that was before Cardinal announced a three-for-two stock split.
Wednesday morning its shares were trading at 61-5/8.
